libXpm 3.5.17 - XPM pixmap format library

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/lib/libXpm-3.5.17.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/libXpm-3.5.17.tar.xz
Extracted to: references/libXpm-3.5.17/ (read-only reference copy)
Copied into third-party/: src/, include/, COPYING (unmodified).

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: driven by third-party/libXpm/CMakeLists.txt, not the upstream
autotools. Our config.h disables the zpipe (gzip/compress pipe)
decompression path since browser wasm has no subprocesses.

libXpm is pulled in for libXaw's Pixmap.c, which registers an XPM
pixmap loader. No direct em-x11 client uses Xpm.

Upgrade procedure: replace references/_tarballs/libXpm-*.tar.xz,
re-extract into references/, diff against third-party/libXpm/, then
re-copy src/ and include/.
